_doc: §164e (2026-09-25): rows after Mar-2016 whose only date is an ASSUMED quarter-end + 21 days (third-party value fills with no exchange timestamp) are served UN-DATED by build_engine_feed, like the pre-Jun-2016 convention rows (§105/§118). An evidenced date (shp_sub_dates.json / shp_lag_fix.json) always wins; remove a key here when one is found.

§164h (2026-09-26): 15 more keys — the §164e sweep tested the SERVED date for the exact quarter-end + 21 signature and missed rows whose assumed date shp_lag_fix had moved to the next trading day (BSE Ltd x9, CDSL x4, SUNDARMFIN, UBL). History slot 5 still holds the exact +21 date, so build_engine_feed's existing test un-dates them.
